_source: Pure analytic. Dec bracketed from JPL DE441 solar ephemeris at year -300, lat -9.56 deg. Formula from Meeus (Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed.) Chapter 22; horizon collimation applied. Lunar standstill extrema from Meeus Chapter 50, no node regression.
_disclaimer: Analytic values are diagnostic for the G14 probe ONLY. Calendar labels are NOT a decipherment and should not be cited as a reading of the Chankillo calendar.
